entries.zh: 是（主詞 I 專用的 be 動詞）
entries.example: I am a student at Sunshine Junior High.
entries.exampleZh: 我是陽光國中的學生。

cloze.sentence: I ___ twelve years old this year.
cloze.fullSentence: I am twelve years old this year.
cloze.translation: 我今年十二歲。
cloze.clue: 主詞是 I 時現在用的 be 動詞

clozeEasy.sentence: Don't worry; I ___ right here behind you.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Don't worry; I am right here behind you.
clozeEasy.translation: 別擔心，我就在你後面。
clozeEasy.clue: 說話者用 I 自稱時的 be 動詞

clozeEasy.sentence: A: Are you ready for the test? B: Yes, I ___.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: A: Are you ready for the test? B: Yes, I am.
clozeEasy.translation: A：你準備好考試了嗎？B：是的，我準備好了。
clozeEasy.clue: 回答 Are you…? 的固定簡答

clozeMedium.sentence: I ___ not good at math, but I keep practicing every day.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: I am not good at math, but I keep practicing every day.
clozeMedium.translation: 我數學不好，但我每天持續練習。
clozeMedium.clue: I 加 not 表示現在「我不是」

clozeMedium.sentence: My brother is tall, but I ___ short.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: My brother is tall, but I am short.
clozeMedium.translation: 我哥哥很高，但我很矮。
clozeMedium.clue: 前後對比：he 用 is，I 用另一個

clozeHard.sentence: In the past I feared dogs, but now I ___ not afraid of them.
clozeHard.fullSentence: In the past I feared dogs, but now I am not afraid of them.
clozeHard.translation: 以前我怕狗，但現在我不怕牠們了。
clozeHard.clue: 主詞 I 的現在否定 be 動詞，與 in the past 對比

entries.zh: 是（you / we / they 及複數主詞用的 be 動詞）
entries.example: You are my best friend in the class.
entries.exampleZh: 你是我在班上最好的朋友。

cloze.sentence: Tom and Tim ___ in the school band together.
cloze.fullSentence: Tom and Tim are in the school band together.
cloze.translation: Tom 和 Tim 一起參加學校樂團。
cloze.clue: 兩個人當主詞（=they）的現在 be 動詞

clozeEasy.sentence: We ___ going to the night market this weekend.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: We are going to the night market this weekend.
clozeEasy.translation: 我們這個週末要去夜市。
clozeEasy.clue: 主詞 we 的現在 be 動詞

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ your parents at home right this minute?
clozeEasy.fullSentence: are your parents at home right this minute?
clozeEasy.translation: 你的爸媽此刻在家嗎？
clozeEasy.clue: 主詞 your parents，現在問句開頭

clozeMedium.sentence: There ___ four seasons in a year.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: There are four seasons in a year.
clozeMedium.translation: 一年有四季。
clozeMedium.clue: There be 句型，後面是 four seasons（複數）

clozeMedium.sentence: The windows ___ dirty, so Dad cleans them every Sunday.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The windows are dirty, so Dad cleans them every Sunday.
clozeMedium.translation: 窗戶很髒，所以爸爸每個星期天清洗。
clozeMedium.clue: 主詞 the windows 是複數

clozeHard.sentence: Where ___ you going? — To the library.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Where are you going? — To the library.
clozeHard.translation: 你要去哪裡？——去圖書館。
clozeHard.clue: 問句主詞 you，現在進行

entries.zh: 是；成為（be 動詞原形）
entries.example: I want to be a doctor in the future.
entries.exampleZh: 我將來想成為醫生。

cloze.sentence: Don't ___ late for school tomorrow.
cloze.fullSentence: Don't be late for school tomorrow.
cloze.translation: 明天上學不要遲到。
cloze.clue: Don't 後面接動詞原形

clozeEasy.sentence: She hopes to ___ a nurse when she grows up.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: She hopes to be a nurse when she grows up.
clozeEasy.translation: 她希望長大後當護士。

clozeEasy.sentence: I'll ___ home all weekend.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: I'll be home all weekend.
clozeEasy.translation: 我整個週末都會在家。

clozeMedium.sentence: You should ___ quiet in the library.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: You should be quiet in the library.
clozeMedium.translation: 在圖書館裡你應該保持安靜。
clozeMedium.clue: should 後面接動詞原形

clozeMedium.sentence: It may ___ rainy tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: It may be rainy tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.
clozeMedium.translation: 明天可能會下雨，所以帶把傘。
clozeMedium.clue: may 後面接動詞原形

clozeHard.sentence: Ken hopes to ___ a pilot, so he studies hard.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Ken hopes to be a pilot, so he studies hard.
clozeHard.translation: Ken 希望成為機師，所以他用功讀書。
clozeHard.clue: to + 動詞原形，表示「成為」

entries.zh: 曾經；已經（be 的過去分詞）
entries.example: I have been to Kenting twice.
entries.exampleZh: 我去過墾丁兩次。

cloze.sentence: She has ___ sick since Monday, so she stays home.
cloze.fullSentence: She has been sick since Monday, so she stays home.
cloze.translation: 她從星期一就一直生病，所以待在家裡。
cloze.clue: has 後面接過去分詞，完成式

clozeEasy.sentence: I have never ___ to Japan, but I hope to go someday.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: I have never been to Japan, but I hope to go someday.
clozeEasy.translation: 我從來沒去過日本，但我希望有天能去。
clozeEasy.clue: have + 過去分詞，表示「去過」

clozeEasy.sentence: Where have you ___? Dinner is cold.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Where have you been? Dinner is cold.
clozeEasy.translation: 你跑去哪裡了？晚餐都涼了。

clozeMedium.sentence: The dog has ___ in the yard for two hours.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The dog has been in the yard for two hours.
clozeMedium.translation: 這隻狗已經在院子裡兩個小時了。
clozeMedium.clue: for + 一段時間，用完成式

clozeMedium.sentence: My dad has ___ a teacher for twenty years.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: My dad has been a teacher for twenty years.
clozeMedium.translation: 我爸當老師已經二十年了。
clozeMedium.clue: has + 過去分詞，持續到現在

clozeHard.sentence: Have you ever ___ to a night market? The food there tastes great.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Have you ever been to a night market? The food there tastes great.
clozeHard.translation: 你去過夜市嗎？那裡的食物很好吃。
clozeHard.clue: Have you ever + 過去分詞，問經驗

entries.zh: 能；會；可以（表示能力或許可）
entries.example: My sister can play the piano very well.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹鋼琴彈得很好。

cloze.sentence: Ben ___ swim across the pool without stopping.
cloze.fullSentence: Ben can swim across the pool without stopping.
cloze.translation: Ben 能不停頓地游過整個泳池。
cloze.clue: 後面直接接動詞原形，表示能力

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ you help me carry this heavy box?
clozeEasy.fullSentence: can you help me carry this heavy box?
clozeEasy.translation: 你能幫我搬這個重箱子嗎？
clozeEasy.clue: 開頭的助動詞，請求幫忙

clozeEasy.sentence: A fish ___ breathe under water.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: A fish can breathe under water.
clozeEasy.translation: 魚能在水下呼吸。

clozeMedium.sentence: Visitors ___ take a free tour every Saturday morning.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Visitors can take a free tour every Saturday morning.
clozeMedium.translation: 訪客每週六可以參加免費導覽。
clozeMedium.clue: 表示「被允許」的規定

clozeMedium.sentence: Dad says we ___ watch one movie tonight.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Dad says we can watch one movie tonight.
clozeMedium.translation: 爸爸說我們今晚可以看一部電影。
clozeMedium.clue: 表示「獲得許可」

clozeHard.sentence: Grandpa is 90, but he still ___ climb the stairs by himself.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Grandpa is 90, but he still can climb the stairs by himself.
clozeHard.translation: 爺爺九十歲了，但仍然能自己爬樓梯。
clozeHard.clue: 高齡仍具備的能力，用現在式

entries.zh: 能；可以（can 的過去式，或更客氣的請求）
entries.example: My grandma could read without glasses when she was young.
entries.exampleZh: 我奶奶年輕時不看眼鏡也能看書。

cloze.sentence: When I was five, I ___ already ride a bike.
cloze.fullSentence: When I was five, I could already ride a bike.
cloze.translation: 我五歲時就會騎腳踏車了。
cloze.clue: 過去擁有的能力

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ you please open the window? It's hot in here.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: could you please open the window? It's hot in here.
clozeEasy.translation: 麻煩你打開窗戶好嗎？這裡很熱。
clozeEasy.clue: 比 can 更客氣的請求

clozeEasy.sentence: The door was locked, but Grandpa ___ open it with his old key.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The door was locked, but Grandpa could open it with his old key.
clozeEasy.translation: 門鎖住了，但爺爺用他的舊鑰匙打得開。

clozeMedium.sentence: I wish I ___ fly like a bird.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: I wish I could fly like a bird.
clozeMedium.translation: 真希望我能像鳥一樣飛。
clozeMedium.clue: 對不可能之事的願望，用過去式助動詞

clozeMedium.sentence: Last night I heard a noise, but I ___ not find out what it was.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Last night I heard a noise, but I could not find out what it was.
clozeMedium.translation: 昨晚我聽到怪聲，但無法查明是什麼。
clozeMedium.clue: 過去「無法」做到

clozeHard.sentence: Excuse me, ___ you tell me where the station is?
clozeHard.fullSentence: Excuse me, could you tell me where the station is?
clozeHard.translation: 不好意思，可以告訴我車站在哪裡嗎？
clozeHard.clue: 問路時最禮貌的開頭

entries.zh: 做（do 的過去式）；助動詞（過去式問句/否定）
entries.example: I did my homework after dinner yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 我昨天晚餐後寫了功課。

cloze.sentence: We ___ a science project about plants last month.
cloze.fullSentence: We did a science project about plants last month.
cloze.translation: 我們上個月做了一個關於植物的科學報告。
cloze.clue: 過去的「做」，主詞 we

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ you finish the book last night?
clozeEasy.fullSentence: did you finish the book last night?
clozeEasy.translation: 你昨晚把那本書看完了嗎？
clozeEasy.clue: 過去問句的開頭助動詞

clozeEasy.sentence: Amy ___ not come to school yesterday because she was sick.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Amy did not come to school yesterday because she was sick.
clozeEasy.translation: Amy 昨天沒來上學，因為她生病了。

clozeMedium.sentence: How ___ you spend your winter vacation? — I visited my grandparents.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: How did you spend your winter vacation? — I visited my grandparents.
clozeMedium.translation: 你的寒假怎麼過的？——我去拜訪祖父母。
clozeMedium.clue: 過去問句：How + 助動詞

clozeMedium.sentence: My mom ___ the laundry and swept the kitchen this morning.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: My mom did the laundry and swept the kitchen this morning.
clozeMedium.translation: 我媽媽今天早上洗了衣服、掃了廚房。
clozeMedium.clue: 過去式的「做（家事）」

clozeHard.sentence: ___ you see the fireworks last night? — Yes, they were beautiful.
clozeHard.fullSentence: did you see the fireworks last night? — Yes, they were beautiful.
clozeHard.translation: 你昨晚看到煙火了嗎？——有，很漂亮。
clozeHard.clue: 對過去事件的問句，用過去式助動詞

entries.zh: 做；助動詞（現在式問句/否定，主詞為 I/you/we/they）
entries.example: What do you do on weekends? — I ride my bike.
entries.exampleZh: 你週末都做什麼？——我騎腳踏車。

cloze.sentence: ___ you like bubble tea? — Yes, I drink it every week.
cloze.fullSentence: do you like bubble tea? — Yes, I drink it every week.
cloze.translation: 你喜歡珍珠奶茶嗎？——喜歡，我每週都喝。
cloze.clue: 現在問句，主詞是 you

clozeEasy.sentence: I always ___ the dishes after dinner.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: I always do the dishes after dinner.
clozeEasy.translation: 我晚餐後總是洗碗。

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ your friends play basketball after school?
clozeEasy.fullSentence: do your friends play basketball after school?
clozeEasy.translation: 你的朋友們放學後打籃球嗎？
clozeEasy.clue: 主詞 your friends 是複數，現在問句

clozeMedium.sentence: We ___ not have class on national holidays.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: We do not have class on national holidays.
clozeMedium.translation: 國定假日我們沒有課。
clozeMedium.clue: 現在否定，主詞 we

clozeMedium.sentence: How much ___ these shoes sell for?
clozeMedium.fullSentence: How much do these shoes sell for?
clozeMedium.translation: 這雙鞋賣多少錢？
clozeMedium.clue: 現在問句，主詞 these shoes 是複數

clozeHard.sentence: ___ your best on the test, and don't give up.
clozeHard.fullSentence: do your best on the test, and don't give up.
clozeHard.translation: 在考試上盡你最大的努力，不要放棄。
clozeHard.clue: 祈使句用原形 do one's best

entries.zh: 做；助動詞（第三人稱單數現在式）
entries.example: My father does exercise every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我爸爸每天早上運動。

cloze.sentence: ___ your brother like spicy food? — No, he hates it.
cloze.fullSentence: does your brother like spicy food? — No, he hates it.
cloze.translation: 你哥哥喜歡吃辣嗎？——不喜歡，他很討厭。
cloze.clue: 現在問句，主詞 your brother 是第三人稱單數

clozeEasy.sentence: She ___ not eat breakfast before six.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: She does not eat breakfast before six.
clozeEasy.translation: 她六點前不吃早餐。

clozeEasy.sentence: Kevin ___ his homework right after school every day.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Kevin does his homework right after school every day.
clozeEasy.translation: Kevin 每天放學後立刻寫功課。

clozeMedium.sentence: Where ___ your mother work? — In a hospital.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Where does your mother work? — In a hospital.
clozeMedium.translation: 你媽媽在哪裡工作？——在醫院。
clozeMedium.clue: 第三人稱單數現在問句

clozeMedium.sentence: ___ Hank play the violin? — Yes, he practices every evening.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: does Hank play the violin? — Yes, he practices every evening.
clozeMedium.translation: Hank 會拉小提琴嗎？——會，他每晚都練習。
clozeMedium.clue: 現在問句，主詞 Hank 單數

clozeHard.sentence: My sister ___ not like coffee, but she loves milk tea.
clozeHard.fullSentence: My sister does not like coffee, but she loves milk tea.
clozeHard.translation: 我妹妹不喜歡咖啡，但她很愛奶茶。
clozeHard.clue: 第三人稱單數否定，後面接原形 like

entries.zh: 做完的；完成（do 的過去分詞）
entries.example: I am almost done with my report.
entries.exampleZh: 我的報告快做完了。

cloze.sentence: The teacher asked if we were ___ with the worksheet.
cloze.fullSentence: The teacher asked if we were done with the worksheet.
cloze.translation: 老師問我們學習單寫完了沒有。
cloze.clue: be done with 表示「做完…」

clozeEasy.sentence: The work is finally ___; we can go home now.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The work is finally done; we can go home now.
clozeEasy.translation: 工作終於完成了，我們可以回家了。
clozeEasy.clue: is + 過去分詞，表示「做完的」

clozeEasy.sentence: All the cakes are ___; the kitchen smells wonderful.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: All the cakes are done; the kitchen smells wonderful.
clozeEasy.translation: 所有的蛋糕都烤好了，廚房聞起來很香。
clozeEasy.clue: are + 過去分詞，表示「完成的」

clozeMedium.sentence: She has ___ her chores, so she can watch TV now.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: She has done her chores, so she can watch TV now.
clozeMedium.translation: 她做完了家事，所以現在可以看電視。
clozeMedium.clue: has + 過去分詞，表示已完成

clozeMedium.sentence: Once the project is ___, we'll celebrate with pizza.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Once the project is done, we'll celebrate with pizza.
clozeMedium.translation: 計畫一完成，我們就要用披薩慶祝。
clozeMedium.clue: is + 過去分詞，表示「完成之後」

clozeHard.sentence: Well ___! You passed the driving test on the first try.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Well done! You passed the driving test on the first try.
clozeHard.translation: 做得好！你第一次就考過駕照了。
clozeHard.clue: 誇獎別人的固定用語

entries.zh: 有（have 的過去式）；had + p.p. 過去完成式
entries.example: We had a great time at the amusement park.
entries.exampleZh: 我們在遊樂園玩得很開心。

cloze.sentence: I ___ a cold last week, so I missed two days of school.
cloze.fullSentence: I had a cold last week, so I missed two days of school.
cloze.translation: 我上星期感冒，所以缺課兩天。
cloze.clue: 過去的「有／得到」

clozeEasy.sentence: The family ___ dinner at Grandma's house last night.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The family had dinner at Grandma's house last night.
clozeEasy.translation: 這家人昨晚在奶奶家吃晚餐。

clozeEasy.sentence: We ___ a picnic in the park last Sunday.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: We had a picnic in the park last Sunday.
clozeEasy.translation: 我們上星期天在公園野餐。

clozeMedium.sentence: By the time we arrived, the movie already ___ started.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: By the time we arrived, the movie already had started.
clozeMedium.translation: 我們抵達時，電影已經開始了。
clozeMedium.clue: 過去完成式 had + 過去分詞

clozeMedium.sentence: We ___ better leave now; the train leaves at six.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: We had better leave now; the train leaves at six.
clozeMedium.translation: 我們最好現在出發，火車六點開。
clozeMedium.clue: had better 表示「最好…」

clozeHard.sentence: After he ___ finished the race, he drank a lot of water.
clozeHard.fullSentence: After he had finished the race, he drank a lot of water.
clozeHard.translation: 他跑完比賽之後，喝了很多水。
clozeHard.clue: 過去完成式 had + 過去分詞，比過去更早

entries.zh: 有（第三人稱單數現在式）；has + p.p. 完成式
entries.example: My uncle has two dogs and a cat.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔養兩隻狗和一隻貓。

cloze.sentence: Angela ___ long hair and big eyes.
cloze.fullSentence: Angela has long hair and big eyes.
cloze.translation: Angela 有長頭髮和大眼睛。
cloze.clue: 第三人稱單數的「有」

clozeEasy.sentence: The bus ___ left; we missed it.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The bus has left; we missed it.
clozeEasy.translation: 公車開走了，我們沒搭到。

clozeEasy.sentence: Everyone in my class ___ a locker.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Everyone in my class has a locker.
clozeEasy.translation: 我們班每個人都有一個置物櫃。

clozeMedium.sentence: Peter ___ studied English for six years.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Peter has studied English for six years.
clozeMedium.translation: Peter 學英文已經六年了。
clozeMedium.clue: for + 一段時間，第三人稱單數完成式

clozeMedium.sentence: A: ___ your sister ever visited Europe? B: No, never.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: A: has your sister ever visited Europe? B: No, never.
clozeMedium.translation: 你姊姊去過歐洲嗎？——從來沒有。
clozeMedium.clue: 第三人稱單數完成式問句

clozeHard.sentence: My grandma ___ lived in this town all her life.
clozeHard.fullSentence: My grandma has lived in this town all her life.
clozeHard.translation: 我奶奶一輩子都住在這個小鎮。
clozeHard.clue: all her life + 完成式，第三人稱單數

entries.zh: 有；have to 必须；have + p.p. 完成式
entries.example: I have a piano lesson on Wednesday.
entries.exampleZh: 我星期三有一堂鋼琴課。

cloze.sentence: The students ___ already finished their science reports.
cloze.fullSentence: The students have already finished their science reports.
cloze.translation: 學生們已經完成他們的科學報告了。
cloze.clue: 複數主詞 + 已經 + 完成式

clozeEasy.sentence: We ___ two tests tomorrow, so I need to study tonight.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: We have two tests tomorrow, so I need to study tonight.
clozeEasy.translation: 我們明天有兩個考試，所以我今晚要讀書。

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ you ever eaten durian? It smells strange but tastes sweet.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: have you ever eaten durian? It smells strange but tastes sweet.
clozeEasy.translation: 你吃過榴槤嗎？味道很怪但吃起來甜。

clozeMedium.sentence: I ___ to clean my room before I go out.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: I have to clean my room before I go out.
clozeMedium.translation: 我出門前必須打掃房間。
clozeMedium.clue: have to 表示「必須」

clozeMedium.sentence: They ___ lived next door to us since 2020.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: They have lived next door to us since 2020.
clozeMedium.translation: 他們從 2020 年起就住在我們隔壁。
clozeMedium.clue: since + 過去時間點，複數完成式

clozeHard.sentence: You should ___ breakfast every morning; it gives you energy.
clozeHard.fullSentence: You should have breakfast every morning; it gives you energy.
clozeHard.translation: 你應該每天早上吃早餐，它給你能量。
clozeHard.clue: should 後接原形 have（吃）

entries.zh: 是（he / she / it 及單數主詞用的 be 動詞）
entries.example: The library is quiet in the afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 圖書館下午很安靜。

cloze.sentence: My favorite subject ___ science.
cloze.fullSentence: My favorite subject is science.
cloze.translation: 我最喜歡的科目是自然。
cloze.clue: 主詞 subject 是單數，現在 be 動詞

clozeEasy.sentence: A: How ___ the weather today? B: It's sunny and warm.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: A: How is the weather today? B: It's sunny and warm.
clozeEasy.translation: 今天天氣如何？——晴天又溫暖。
